context_note: Abstract result: SOC stock in 0-15 cm measured once (2015/2016) at end of study; difference is CC minus no-CC control, not a change from a measured baseline (initial SOC was not quantified). 10-20 range spans both sites and all CC species.

Site A specific range (4.4-10.6 Mg C ha-1); lower bound 4.4 is oat CC, upper bound 10.6 is cereal rye or OSR+Rye. Same caveat as E1: cross-sectional comparison to no-CC control, not change from baseline.

Site B specific range (3.7-18.3 Mg C ha-1); shares quote with E2 but reports site B values. Both rows from same sentence are legitimate since they extract distinct site-specific data. Discussion also reports annual C accumulation rate of 1.1-2.2 Mg C ha-1 yr-1 derived by dividing 9-yr stock by 9, but no additional missed rows needed as headline results are covered.
